text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with intro, body, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a more structured way, with separate paragraphs and a recognizable essay shape."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like \"So I think...\" and \"It benefits for the older students because\"","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay explains its points with more sustained reasoning and examples rather than mostly listing or repeating advice."},{"evidence":"\"For example...\" and school-based scenarios","quality":"use of supporting examples","description":"The essay gives more relevant examples to illustrate its claims and make the argument clearer."},{"evidence":"\"younger students... older students... older students\" throughout","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay links sentences and paragraphs more smoothly with repeated references and transition phrases."},{"evidence":"\"It definitely can help both because\" and \"not only one way but a lot\"","quality":"sentence complexity","description":"The essay uses more varied sentence structures, including cause-effect and compound constructions, to express relationships between ideas."},{"evidence":"\"communication skills,\" \"become more secure about themselves,\" \"pursue your teaching career\"","quality":"word choice","description":"The essay shows a somewhat more precise academic vocabulary for discussing skills, benefits, and future goals."}]}
